QuestInfo.name: The Lost Piece of the VIP Ticket
QuestInfo.0: Where did the ripped piece of the VIP ticket go? I better go see Kevin the Soldier.
QuestInfo.1: The ripped piece of the VIP ticket is missing, so I went to Kevin the Soldier for its whereabouts. Kevin wound up picking up the ticket after I left.
QuestInfo.2: I was looking for the ripped piece of the VIP ticket for a looong time, and I found out that the ones I dropped, Kevin the Soldier managed to pick them up and save them. Phew!

0.0: 당신을 기다리고 있었어요. 당신이 떠나고 난 뒤에 보니 찢어진 자유여행권을 흘리고 가셨더군요. 여기 어디다가 잘 두었는데 찾아볼게요. 잠시 후에 다시 말을 걸어주세요.
I've been waiting for you here. You left your ripped travel ticket on the ground after you left here. I'll check out the place and see if I can find it. Talk to me in a little bit.
